newsitem.title: MEXICO: Weekly Mexican export, import feeder summary - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Weekly Mexican export, import feeder summary - USDA.

text.p: USDA said Friday that steer calves exported to the United States from Mexico sold two cent/lb lower than two weeks ago.
Feeder exports for the week were estimated at 9,500 head into Texas and New Mexico states. Confirmed exports for the previous week totaled 1,416 head, against 1,833 head in the same week in 1996.
Prices for feeder steers weighing 300-400 lb were 91-101 cents/lb, for 400-500 lb they were 81-91 cents/lb and 500-600 lb they were 76-81 cents/lb
Imports into Mexico were estimated to have totaled 1,500 head for the week, it added. "Higher prices for slaugher cows and bulls has created lower numbers to be exported (to Mexico)," USDA said.
